title_en: Indonesia's logistics performance among Asia-Pacific countries
visual_description_id: Dua panel. Kiri: diagram gelembung Kinerja Logistik (Logistics Performance Index 2018, sumbu y 2–5) terhadap Skor Infrastruktur (Global Competitiveness Index 2019, sumbu x 50–100); Indonesia dilingkari merah putus-putus bersama Thailand, Viet Nam, India, China, Malaysia; Singapura, Jepang, Korea Selatan di kanan atas; Filipina dan Laos di kiri bawah. visual_description_en: Two panels. Left: bubble chart of Logistics Performance Index 2018 (y, 2–5) vs. GCI 2019 infrastructure score (x, 50–100). Right: bar chart of LPI 2018 scores — Singapore 4.3, Japan 3.9, Malaysia 3.6, Thailand 3.5, India 3.4, Vietnam 3.3, Indonesia 3.0 (highlighted yellow), Bangladesh 2.6, Cambodia 2.4.

visual_description_en: Map of the six Papuan provinces (Papua Barat Daya, Papua Barat, Papua Tengah, Papua, Papua Pegunungan, Papua Selatan) with 42 numbered districts. Marks priority tourism DPP Raja Ampat and development destination Biak–Teluk Cendrawasih, KEK Sorong, KI Teluk Bintuni (LNG/petrochemicals), fisheries centres SKPT Biak Numfor, Mimika and Merauke, KPPN Raja Ampat, Manokwari and Merauke, border PKSN Tanah Merah and Merauke, new city Sorong, small city Jayapura, plus commodity icons (coffee, coconut, oil palm, nutmeg, candlenut, cocoa, rice, maize, sweet potato, cassava, sago, peanuts/mung beans, soybean, horticulture, poultry, cattle, goats, pigs, eggs, fisheries) and mining icons (gold, copper, nickel, oil & gas).

DPP Raja Ampat -> Papua Barat Daya

title_id: Transformasi Sosial dalam Pemenuhan SDM Unggul di Wilayah Bali-Nusa Tenggara
title_en: Social-transformation interventions for human-capital development in Bali–Nusa Tenggara
visual_description_id: Peta Bali (merah), NTB (cokelat), NTT (hijau) skala 1:5.000.000 dengan kabupaten bernomor dan ikon intervensi per kabupaten: pengembangan fasilitas pendidikan berbasis sektor unggulan (biru/topi wisuda), fasilitas kesehatan terakreditasi (merah/plus), akses internet berkecepatan tinggi (hijau), akses air minum dan sanitasi layak (biru/air), dan peningkatan akses rumah layak huni (kuning/rumah). Hampir setiap kabupaten NTT mendapat ikon pendidikan, kesehatan dan internet; ikon air-sanitasi dan rumah layak tersebar di Sumba, Flores, Timor, Lombok, Sumbawa dan Bali utara/timur.
visual_description_en: Map of Bali (red), NTB (brown) and NTT (green), 1:5,000,000, with numbered districts and per-district intervention icons: education facilities tied to leading sectors (blue mortar-board), accredited health facilities (red cross), high-speed internet access (green), safe water & sanitation access (blue drop), and decent housing (yellow house). Nearly every NTT district carries the education, health and internet icons; water-sanitation and housing icons appear across Sumba, Flores, Timor, Lombok, Sumbawa and north/east Bali. A 22-item NTT district key is printed.
